links_touching_record.rationale: Static-analysis deviation record for FB2-SW-DEV-000016 (src/app/driver/spi/spi_cfg-helper.h) mined from the in-source Axivion MisraC2012 style-check suppression. Directly within the ownership of FB2-SW-DSN-000001: the design element exposes the AFE_SPI interface (interface_id AFE_SPI, bidirectional, spi_tx/spi_rx) and these defines are the per-slave hardware chip-select masks that drive the CSn lines of that interface. The design's constraints record 'SPI clock <= 1 MHz (LTC6811 spec)' and its decision DEC-AFE-002 splits voltage and temperature reads, both of which depend on the CSn values these masks produce. Relation meaning: the deviation record refines the design element with an evidence-backed, code-level documented exception. The record is NOT a verification of the design element - it performs no test, produces no result and provides no coverage of any requirement. It documents an implementation exception observed in the code that implements the design element, so an auditor can see that the design element's implementation carries a recorded, justified deviation from the project's stated MISRA C:2012 compatibility requirement. The link asserts the existence of the recorded deviation only; it does NOT assert MISRA conformance, tool qualification, or a completed ISO 26262 or ASPICE assessment.

FB2-REV-000002 reviewed FB2-SW-DEV-000016 at revision 1 and enumerates it in reviewed_ids with the sha256 of the artifact's content at review time. Direction follows the pre-existing reviewed_by links in this registry, which run review -> artifact.

corpus_scope.query: graft grep "AXIVION Disable Style MisraC2012" -i (repo root)
corpus_scope.scope_note: This set is 26 deviation records, one per (file, symbol) group, and covers all 43 'AXIVION Disable Style MisraC2012*' annotation lines found under src/ at commit 308028fb. Those 43 annotation lines fall in 20 files, and every one of the 43 is represented in the affected_lines of a record. 26 records cover 43 annotation lines over 26 distinct (file, symbol) groups because, where one symbol carries more than one MisraC2012 rule, the additional Disable lines appear as further entries in the same record's deviations array instead of as separate records. Axivion annotations outside this query are not mined by this set, and their absence must not be read as 'no deviation': 'AXIVION Routine Generic-MissingParameterAssert', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Style MisraC2012*', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Generic-LocalInclude', 'AXIVION Next Codeline CodingStyle-Naming.*', 'AXIVION Next Codeline IISB-LiteralSuffixesCheck', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Generic-NoEllipsis', 'AXIVION Next Codeline Generic-ForbiddenFunctions', 'AXIVION Routine FaultDetection-DivisionByZero', and the 'AXIVION Routine MisraC2012Directive-4.1' / 'AXIVION Routine MisraC2012-2.7' annotations. Non-MISRA families that share one of the 43 mined annotation lines ARE recorded, per record, in tool_reference.co_located_non_misra_checks and in the corresponding deviations entry (for example Generic-NoUnsafeMacro, CertC-PRE01, Generic-NoEmptyLoops, Generic-DoxygenCommentInHeader, Generic-NoMagicNumbers, IISB-LiteralSuffixesCheck); out-of-query suppression sites on the same symbol are likewise listed in the record's deviations array with a note, so that each record's rule exposure is complete for the symbol it names.

deviations.deviation_rationale: Redundant expressions are kept to enhance code readability

impact_notes.note: Each mask ORs six shifted literals into the CSNR field: five carry SPI_HARDWARE_CHIP_SELECT_NOT_ACTIVE (1) and exactly one carries SPI_HARDWARE_CHIP_SELECT_ACTIVE (0). Spelling out all six positions, including the zero-valued one, is what makes the de-selected line explicit. A wrong term changes which AFE slave is selected, i.e. which cell voltages are read.

The rationale is a readability trade-off, which is the weakest justification class in this set: the same result can be obtained by a table-driven or single-mask formulation that static analysis accepts.
The masks are exercised only through the AFE driver path; no as_is unit-test artifact in the corpus targets spi_cfg-helper.h directly.

project_process_evidence.what_it_states: Project-level MUST: 'Code contributed to this project **MUST** be compatible with MISRA C:2012 which is described in :cite:`MISRA-C:2012`.' This is the only occurrence of 'MISRA' in the whole pinned docs/ tree and is the statement every suppression in this record set is a deviation from.

C:015 defines the project's only documented in-source deviation annotation syntax: 'If no assertion can be made for the parameter ... the parameter **MUST** be marked like this at the start of the function context: /* AXIVION Routine Generic-MissingParameterAssert: *ENTITY_NAME*: *RATIONALE* */.' The written guideline therefore mandates the '<ENTITY>: <RATIONALE>' annotation shape for one Axivion check family only; the MisraC2012 style-check family follows the same shape in practice but is not covered by any C:001..C:033 rule.

The project's own C coding guideline is a 33-rule set (C:001..C:033) with an 'Automated Check' column. Only C:002, C:004, C:005, C:006 and C:029 are marked 'Yes'; no rule in the set corresponds to a MisraC2012 style check, so the guideline set does not govern the rules these suppressions waive.

The third-party tool criticality table classifies git, TI ARM CGT, gcc, vs-code, waf, sphinx, ceedling and a custom HIL runner. No static-analysis tool (Axivion, cppcheck or equivalent) is classified, so no tool criticality or qualification basis for the tool that produced these suppressions is recorded in the repository.

record_verbatim.reanalysis_justification: Seven separate, identical Disable/Enable pairs, one per chip-select mask, at 79/89, 93/103, 107/117, 121/131, 135/145, 149/159 and 163/173; each pair is also wrapped in clang-format off/on. The masks must be re-analysed whenever a chip-select bit position constant changes, whenever a new CS line is added, and whenever the surrounding clang-format region is moved, because the suppression is scoped to source-line adjacency. A consolidation of the seven masks into a single block-level suppression would be a legitimate simplification but would also hide any new 2.2 finding in the same header.
record_verbatim.review_disposition_note: Governance evidence search at the pinned baseline: no deviance log, deviation log, suppression register, waiver file or review record for the MisraC2012 style checks exists anywhere in the repository (searched for *deviance*, *deviation*, *misra*, *axivion* file names and for 'AXIVION' across docs/). docs/tools/static-analysis/ and conf/spa/ do not exist at this commit. The rationale text below is therefore the only recorded justification.

required_elements: 2. approved_by - a named individual, not a role and not a team

3. role - a role_id declared in role-and-review-policy.json#/roles - plus independence{owner_role, satisfied, evidence, policy_ref}; the approving role must differ from owner_role AND from the author of the last content revision

signature_block._packet_sha256_note: The digest of this packet.json's own bytes. It is deliberately left null rather than filled, because a file cannot contain its own digest. Compute it with `shasum -a 256`, or use `--transcribe`, which resolves it.
signature_block._recording: Transcribe a completed signature into the record as human_approval_status plus an approval_evidence.human_approval block plus a revision_history entry naming the reviewer and citing this packet, and archive the signed packet under docs/artifacts/reviews/signed/.
signature_block._rule: Empty by construction. No automated process may fill this. Filling it in is the only thing that changes human_approval_status on the record. As of 2026-10-04 (amendment APPROVAL-RULE-A1) the corpus rule human_approval_rejected is an EVIDENCE requirement, not a prohibition: a properly evidenced approval is ACCEPTED and keeps `corpus.py check` green, while a bare grant value is still rejected. What the validator reads is contract.approval_evidence_block below; it fails if any of its six elements is missing, and the finding names which.

signature_policy: The signature block below is empty by construction. This tool has no code path that writes a decision, an approval, a signature or an execution verdict. Filling it is a human action. As of 2026-10-04 (amendment APPROVAL-RULE-A1) the corpus ACCEPTS a properly evidenced approval rather than banning the value outright, so this rule now has to carry the evidence contract in full: see signature_block._contract.
